description: This file contains unit tests for the EmailTemplate module in SuiteCRM, testing various functionalities such as parsing templates, generating JavaScript field definitions, handling images, and other business logic related to email templates.

classes.name: EmailTemplateTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmailTemplates module in SuiteCRM, covering methods for parsing, creation, and data handling.

methods.name: testEmailTemplateParser
methods.description: Tests the parsing of email templates with different beans.

methods.name: testEmailTemplateParserUser
methods.description: Tests parsing of email templates with a user bean.

methods.name: testcreateCopyTemplate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a copy of an email template via UI request simulation.

methods.name: testaddDomainToRelativeImagesSrc
methods.description: Tests the functionality that adds domain URLs to relative image sources.

methods.name: testrepairEntryPointImages
methods.description: Tests the repair of image URLs that are entry point download links.

methods.name: testEmailTemplate
methods.description: Validates constructor and object properties of EmailTemplate beans.

methods.name: testgenerateFieldDefsJS
methods.description: Tests the generation of JavaScript field definitions for email templates.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Verifies the get_summary_text method returns correct summary information.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Tests the creation of export SQL queries for email templates.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Ensures fill_in_additional_list_fields executes without error.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Tests the filling of additional detail fields and their correct population.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields_body_to_text
methods.description: Validates HTML to plain text conversion during filling additional details.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_parent_fields
methods.description: Checks execution of fill_in_additional_parent_fields method.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Validates the list view data returned by EmailTemplates.

methods.name: testparse_email_templateAndParse_tracker_urls
methods.description: Tests parsing email templates and tracker URLs within templates.

methods.name: _convertToType
methods.description: Tests type conversion utility method.

methods.name: test_parseUserValues
methods.description: Incomplete test for parsing user-related values; marked as incomplete due to PHP version differences.

methods.name: testparse_template_bean
methods.description: Tests the parse_template_bean method with various module inputs.

methods.name: testparse_template
methods.description: Tests the parse_template method with different array inputs.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Verifies whether beans implement specific interfaces or features.

methods.name: testgetTypeOptionsForSearch
methods.description: Validates the static method returning type options for search filters.

methods.name: testis_used_by_email_marketing
methods.description: Checks if email templates are correctly flagged as used for email marketing.

methods.name: testcleanBean
methods.description: Tests the cleanBean function, especially HTML escaping of body_html.
